newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Bel-20 ends down, finds support at 1,750.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bel-20 ends down, finds support at 1,750.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Belgian shares end just above session lows, extending morning losses after Dow Jones dropped 51 points in thin volume in the afternoon. Focus now on U.S. policy-making FOMC meeting Tuesday with opinion divided over whether Fed will hike short term rates.

* Newly reweighted Bel-20 index .BFX ended 14.42 points or 0.82 percent lower at 1,750.64, with chart support seen at current levels. Belgian share volume moderate 2.1 billion francs worth of shares compared to massive 8.9 billion bfr Friday.
* Bekaert in correction now pressure of a negative Bel-20 weighting out of the way, ended 0.9 percent up at 23,300.
